issue.title: drift(live-agents-snapshot): the 2026-09-25 snapshot carries pre-amendment copies of the retired live-agents rule
issue.body:
## Why
RAPP proposal 0001, *Only top-level agents are live* ([kody-w/RAPP#119](https://github.com/kody-w/RAPP/pull/119), squash-merged as `a879530`), was implemented by the constitutional amendment [kody-w/RAPP#124](https://github.com/kody-w/RAPP/pull/124) (`e045fc3`). The governing rule: in the local Brainstem, live agents come only from the top-level `agents/*_agent.py` files, hot-loaded on every `/chat` request; every folder under `agents/` is organization only and never loads, whatever its name (`experimental_agents/`, `disabled_agents/` and `workspace_agents/` included); loading or unloading an agent is a plain file move, meaning drag and drop. The grail's loader (`kody-w/rapp-installer@brainstem-v0.6.9`, `rapp_brainstem/brainstem.py` lines 1202-1205) globs one level only.

RAPP Constitution Article LIII.1 ("Ratify → sweep → file, same session") says an amendment is not "done" until the retired form has been hunted ecosystem-wide and every hit carries a `drift()` issue. This issue is this repository's hit from that sweep. (RAPP's own hits are kody-w/RAPP#126 to #130.)

This snapshot was captured on 2026-09-25 between 13:44 and 13:50 UTC (`MANIFEST.json`), before kody-w/RAPP#124 merged, and it holds copies of upstream files that state the retired form.

## Severity
Low — a snapshot of other repositories; each copy is corrected upstream, not here.

## Where
All under `repos/` at `kody-w/rapp-monorepo@64fa4935eec40aace6e0b73286c30088db72fb57`:
- `repos/RAPP/` (captured at `8afc973`, before #124):
  - `CONSTITUTION.md` lines 909-916, 918-921, 930-934, 936-947, 949-959, 973-975, 979-982, 985-986 and 988-999 (Article XVII), 1019, 1024-1026, 1029-1032, 1059-1061 and 1070-1072 (Article XVIII), and 1143-1144, 1154-1155 and 1167-1168 (Article XX), and `pages/docs/SPEC.md` lines 786-788. Upstream now governs these lines with #124's dated notes.
  - `CONSTITUTION.md` lines 923-928 (the Article XVII starter set), `rapp_brainstem/CONSTITUTION.md`, `rapp_brainstem/.gitignore` lines 26-28, `pages/product/faq.html` line 191, `pages/vault/Blog Drafts/the-experimental-graveyard.md`, `pages/vault/Plans & Ledgers/Blog Roadmap.md` line 120, `pages/vault/content-bundle.json` line 40 and `README.md` line 134: the same hits as kody-w/RAPP#126 to #130.
- `repos/RAPP-Bible/SPEC/kernel/CONSTITUTION.md`, `SPEC/kernel/SPEC.md` lines 788-790 and `SPEC/mcp/SPEC.md` lines 110-112: see kody-w/RAPP-Bible#24.
- `repos/rapp-spine/specs/KERNEL.md` lines 140, 177, 262 and 297, and `specs/PARITY.md` lines 109-110: see kody-w/rapp-spine#18.
- `repos/rapp-distro/SPEC.md` line 11: see kody-w/rapp-distro#2.
- `repos/rapp-static-apis/rapp-twin.profile.md` lines 74-75: see kody-w/rapp-static-apis#129.
- `repos/rapp-brainstem-plugin/src/rapp_brainstem_gateway/agents.py` line 56: see kody-w/rapp-brainstem-plugin#5.
- `repos/rapp-mcp/rapp_mcp.py` lines 107-110, `SPEC.md` lines 108-110 and `docs/index.html` lines 760-761: see kody-w/rapp-mcp#5.
- `repos/rapp-constitution/CONSTITUTION.md`, at the same lines as the `repos/RAPP/CONSTITUTION.md` copy. Its upstream, `kody-w/rapp-constitution`, is a declared mirror of kody-w/RAPP's `CONSTITUTION.md` (with a byte-for-byte drift check), so a re-sync from RAPP `main` corrects it; it is not in the RAPP portfolio list this sweep covered (`kody-w/rapp-hive-public` `portfolio/repos/`), so no issue was filed there.

The snapshot's other matches are not hits: release notes, version tables and historical vault notes, legacy test fixtures, the preserved Tier 2 `rapp_swarm/build.sh`, management-UI folder labels (a UI convention the amendment allows), and unrelated uses of the same words.

## Suggested fix
Don't hand-edit the copies: they record exact upstream commits (RAPP Constitution Article LIII.6 treats mirrors as re-sync only). Refresh the snapshot as the upstream issues are resolved. A refresh now already brings in RAPP's #124 notes.

Update the two list entries to `rapp-mcp-spec/2.0`, then rebuild `estate-map.json` locally with `python3 tools/spine.py map` (`SPINE.md` line 57); it is never hand-edited, and the `spine.yml` workflow's recent push runs have failed, so don't rely on it.
